$comment: Declares which program each packages/* package belongs to, who that program addresses, which packages are primitives that deliberately ship no gate, and which are published but classified into no program yet. See docs/DECISIONS.md#11-a-gate-behind-a-bin-or-a-declared-primitive, which this file is the machine-readable half of. The rule: a program package names a doer, answers one question only it answers, and ships a gate behind a `bin`; a primitive declares that it ships none, and why. scripts/check-package-tier.mjs enforces the half that can pass today -- every live package under packages/ appears exactly once here, and every name declared here is a real package -- and runs in `npm run check`. It deliberately does NOT yet enforce the `bin` half: that check would today fail on the three known-missing gates listed under "awaitingProgram" rather than on drift, so it follows the packages that can satisfy it (see the script header). Deprecated and retired donors are neither required nor forbidden here; they are declared in package-retention.json against the decision that superseded them.

programs.name: interaction

roles.name: bouncer
roles.about: who you are, what you can do, how that changes
roles.question: Is this actor who they claim, and is this inside what they were granted?

roles.name: butler
roles.about: what you want -- now, and standing
roles.question: Do we have what this person wants, in their own confirmation, and still current?

roles.name: giver
roles.about: what you get -- asked for, and owed
roles.question: Did they get what they asked for, a reason, or a human -- and everything owed, on time?

roles.name: keeper
roles.about: what you gave us, and what we understand from it
roles.question: Does everything we hold trace to something they did, and can they see and correct it?

programs.$comment: The roles are named and their questions fixed; none is cut, and no package here corresponds to one yet. This program's three donors -- @vespeneventures/auth, @vespeneventures/comms and @vespeneventures/consent -- are declared under "awaitingProgram" below rather than here: they are donors-to-be, not roles, and listing them as interaction's packages would claim a membership that does not exist yet.

programs.name: transaction
programs.$comment: Named so that its absence is a decision rather than an oversight. Nothing in this repository waits on it.

primitives.name: @vespeneventures/domain
primitives.reason: No addressee, therefore no role, therefore no question only it answers. It defines identifiers, typed fields, closed vocabularies and relations and ships no values, storage, authorization, provenance or lifecycle of its own, so the only thing a gate of its own could judge is the consumer's model -- which is the consumer's judgment to make, not this package's. Its checkers are library functions a consumer's own gate calls, not a command this package installs.

$comment:awaitingProgram: Published, belongs to no program yet, and ships no gate because nobody has built one. This state exists so the three packages docs/DECISIONS.md 11 is derived from are visible in its machine-readable half instead of absent from it. It is NOT the primitive tier -- each of these addresses one person, so each owes a gate -- and it is not a membership in "interaction" either, since none of them is one of that program's four roles. Every entry carries a "resolvedBy": an unclassified package with no named resolution is the standing exemption with no expiry that package-retention.json already refuses.

awaitingProgram.name: @vespeneventures/auth
awaitingProgram.reason: Donor to the unbuilt `bouncer` role -- who you are, what you can do, and how that changes. Published with no `bin`, so no consumer's CI can check it: the gate is known-missing, not deliberately absent.
awaitingProgram.resolvedBy: docs/DECISIONS.md#11-a-gate-behind-a-bin-or-a-declared-primitive; cut of the role packages, then issue #464 (retire the Program C donors)

awaitingProgram.name: @vespeneventures/comms
awaitingProgram.intendedProgram: interaction (not cut; its inbound half and its dispatch half do not answer to the same role)
awaitingProgram.reason: Donor to the unbuilt interaction roles, split across more than one of them, so no single program membership is true of it today. Published with no `bin`, which is why src/dispatcher.ts's unwired-policy fail-open has no CLI that could fail on it: the founding defect recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md 11.
awaitingProgram.resolvedBy: docs/DECISIONS.md#11-a-gate-behind-a-bin-or-a-declared-primitive; cut of the role packages, then issue #464 (retire the Program C donors)

awaitingProgram.name: @vespeneventures/consent
awaitingProgram.reason: Donor to the unbuilt `butler` role. Ships the three-state model that its sibling donor's fail-open contradicts, and no `bin` from which either could be checked.
awaitingProgram.resolvedBy: docs/DECISIONS.md#11-a-gate-behind-a-bin-or-a-declared-primitive; cut of the role packages, then issue #464 (retire the Program C donors)
